rule.name: KeywordRegexOverSource
rule.message: This matches a keyword of a programming language (case, import, class, require) with a regular expression over raw source text. Comments, strings and text blocks match as well ("in this case" matches case), so a rewrite or a count driven by the match changes or counts text that is not code, and a scan that continues from the match runs into the next lines. Use a parser or a tokenizer, or blank out comments, strings and text blocks first (call a method such as stripComments or maskStrings in the same method). An exception fits a throwaway script where a false match is harmless.
